title: Content Associate
description:
**Position Overview**

We are looking for an all-rounder Content & Marketing Associate to help make SUIND's work visible, understandable, and exciting. You will travel to the field, meet farmers, and turn real deployment stories into compelling video, graphic, and written content — from first shoot to final publish.

**What You'll Do**

* Travel to field locations to shoot farmer testimonials, drone demos, and product stories.
* Shoot, edit, and publish short-form video content end-to-end for LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, and other channels.
* Present confidently on camera and help others tell their story naturally.
* Design brochures, flyers, pitch decks, case studies, and marketing collateral.
* Write technical explainers, captions, and product communication that simplify complex technology.
* Take ownership of social-media channels — deciding formats, riding trends, and reviewing engagement.
* Coordinate with the operations team to schedule and join early-morning field shoots.
* Organise and maintain photo, video, and content libraries.

**What You'll BringMust-Have**

* 1-3 years of experience in content creation, video production, marketing, or technical communication.
* A demonstrable portfolio of video work.
* Strong spoken communication in English and Hindi.
* Comfort presenting on camera without a script.
* End-to-end video shooting and editing skills.
* Willingness to travel to remote, rural field locations.
* Genuine curiosity about drones and agricultural technology.

**Good-to-Have**

* Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator) or similar tools.
* Understanding of social-media algorithms, trends, and content analytics.
* Ability to create or coordinate regional-language content.
* Experience creating sales collateral, case studies, or customer testimonials.
* Openness to learning basic drone-data concepts.

**Logistics**

* **Employment Type:** Full-time
* **Department:** Marketing
* **Location:** Bangalore, Karnataka
* **Work Mode:** On-site (with occasional field travel)
* **Travel:** Occasional, to remote field locations across Maharashtra and Kerala

Pay: ₹300,128.25 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Experience:

* Content creation: 1 year (Required)
* Video editing: 1 year (Required)

Location:

* Bengaluru, Karnataka (Bengaluru, Bengaluru Urban District) (Required)

Work Location: In person
fit_rationale: Target role fit: 98/100. Focus: B2B sales & outbound pipeline alignment (Pencil Mark / AERO India), AI data annotation & evaluation alignment (Instawork AI Data).
